patterns.note: Sections feature generous vertical padding and horizontally centered content, creating an airy and balanced composition with ample negative space.

A striking, oversized, high-contrast serif font is used for primary headings and display text, creating an elegant and editorial feel, contrasted with a clean, legible sans-serif for body copy and navigation.
The site predominantly uses a warm, light cream background, providing a soft canvas for dark, rich brown text, with subtle warm accent tones for highlights and interactive elements.
The main navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport throughout scrolling. Content sections appear to reveal with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport.

Key information is presented in distinct, full-width sections, often featuring a large, singular heading followed by a concise block of text or a visual element, maintaining a focused and uncluttered presentation.

technique_notes: The hero section features a dynamic, abstract background that subtly animates using WebGL or canvas, providing a sophisticated visual texture without distracting from the primary message.
Navigation elements are fixed to the top of the viewport, maintaining accessibility across all scroll depths without visual transformation.

Content sections are designed to reveal themselves with a gentle, staggered fade-up or slide-in effect as the user scrolls down the page, enhancing engagement and guiding attention through the content flow.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized, elegant serif headings (~4-5x body) with high contrast strokes, complemented by a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and smaller uppercase labels.
design_tokens.spacing: very airy, with significant vertical spacing between sections and generous horizontal margins, creating a sense of luxury and openness.

standout: The site's distinctive design lies in its masterful use of negative space, creating an exceptionally airy and luxurious feel. This is paired with a sophisticated, subtly animated WebGL hero background and elegant, oversized serif typography, which together elevate the content beyond a typical corporate presentation.
